text: **Browse Category Hierarchy** For larger numbers of available products when they know they want something that performs a certain function or has a certain form, and they look at the top level product categories and see something relevant to that function they may choose to select that top level category. Once that top level category is selected with that same function in mind they may choose a sub-category that more closely matches the form or function they have in mind. This may be repeated until they go down deep enough to find the category that represents the set of available products relevant to the form or function in mind.
